reason: A workspace file utility that supports drag-and-drop intake, @file references, file browsing with Git status, multi-tab viewing, and manual text-file editing and saving.

summaries.zh: 用于在会话工作区中拖拽、浏览、引用、查看和编辑文件的 Web 插件。
summaries.en: A web plugin for dragging, browsing, referencing, viewing, and editing files in the session workspace.

capabilities: Reads files from the current session workspace
Writes manually edited text files back to disk
Copies dragged files into the session workspace attachments directory
Displays Git status for workspace files
Adds a persistent file browser and multi-tab viewer to the web interface
